quote.translation: Even with something like a storm, natural science seeks some lawlike necessity or probability, taking into account as causes the distribution of land and sea, changes in weather, temperature and air pressure, and so on, so that if these definite conditions are fulfilled, the same storm phenomenon is produced any number of times, necessarily or with the greatest probability.

regions.text: 然性を以て生み出されるのである。たとへ暴風の中心がつねに一定の地點に存し愛生の時期もまた一定の季節に限局されてあるやうな場合でも自然科の開心は暴風現象の抽象的周期性に存してるる。

quote.translation: Even where the centre of a storm always lies at a fixed point and its occurrence is confined to a fixed season, the concern of natural science lies in the abstract periodicity of the storm phenomenon.

regions.text: 法則の必然性普遍性が抽象的に明かにされなければならぬ。

quote.translation: The necessity and universality of the law must be made clear in the abstract, and it is on this basis that the future can be predicted and defensive installations planned.

regions.text: そこに未来の豫知も可能であり防禦所施設も考慮されるのである。

quote.translation: Saying probability instead of necessity makes no difference whatever to the idea.

regions.text: 必然性といふ代りに蓋然性と云つて見ても理念に於ては何箏の變りはない。

quote.translation: For history, on the other hand, what is in question is the storm that arose in such-and-such a year and month, at such-and-such a place, in its once-only character and in its full concreteness.

regions.text: それに反して歴史にとつては何年何月何處共盛に起つた暴厲がその一同性に於てその全具體性のままに於て問題である。

quote.translation: That a storm arose near Takashima in Hizen on the first day of the intercalary seventh month of Kōan 4 is, for history, a matter of concern in its full concreteness.

regions.text: 弘安四年閣七月一日に肥前鷹島附近に暴風が起のたといふことは歴史にとつてはその至具後性に於て眺心事である。元泡に際して総山上空は願文を伊勢神宮に呈し身を以て図難に代らうとせられた。

quote.translation: At the time of the Mongol invasion the Retired Emperor Kameyama presented a votive prayer to the Ise Shrine and sought to take the national crisis upon his own person, and Hōjō Tokimune showed his firm resolve by beheading the Yuan envoys at Tatsunokuchi.

regions.text: 北條時宗は元の使者を龍ノ口に概つて堅い決意を示した。・弘安四年関七月一日鷹島附近に暴風が起ってその精果、激軍數萬が海中に壊滅したといふことは「伊勢の神風」として史上特筆すべき偶然である。

quote.translation: That a storm arose near Takashima on that day, and that as a result an enemy army of several tens of thousands perished in the sea, is a chance that history singles out for special mention as "the divine wind of Ise".

regions.text: 歴史の非合理性は空間時間の一同的限定に基きまたこの具體肪限定を背景として偶然性が現象するのである。

quote.translation: The irrationality of history, in other words, rests on the once-only delimitation of space and time, and it is against the background of this concrete delimitation that contingency appears.

regions.text: 「偶然町の大きな祭典の日に、人

quote.translation: "By chance, on the day of a great festival in the town, among the crowds gathered there, at the time when the two of us first met, we were at once, just as we were, bound together most closely; and since then nothing has been as close to the two of us as we were to each other" (Montaigne, Essays, I, trans. Sekine Hideo, pp. 347-348).
